description: The bar chart illustrates classification accuracy (in percent) for several methods from the referenced paper, shown as a single set of colored bars with a legend identifying each method. The category axis is horizontal with six unlabeled bar positions corresponding to the legend entries (RoBERTa w/o Exp., RoBERTa, LaSQuE (mean), LaSQuE, LaSQuE (syn2real), and LaSQuE (syn2real + curriculum)), and the value axis is vertical labeled “Accuracy (%)” on a linear scale with tick marks at 40%, 45%, 50%, 55%, 60%, and 65%. The bars are colored light gray (RoBERTa w/o Exp.) at approximately 46–47%, light blue (RoBERTa) at about 55%, orange (LaSQuE (mean)) at about 47%, green (LaSQuE) at about 47%, purple (LaSQuE (syn2real)) at about 59%, and dark gray (LaSQuE (syn2real + curriculum)) at about 62%. The bars are not stacked or grouped beyond being placed side-by-side, there are no visible annotations on individual bars, and the ordering appears to follow the legend listing rather than an explicit sorted scheme.
